content.Initial Laboratory and Electrocardiograp: The guideline discusses the use of biomarkers and laboratory tests in heart failure diagnosis. It highlights the role of genetic testing and biomarker measurements such as N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) in diagnosing and managing heart failure.
content.Use of Biomarkers for Prevention, Initia: The guideline emphasizes the utility of biomarkers, specifically BNP and NT-proBNP, for diagnosing heart failure, risk stratification, and predicting outcomes in heart failure patients.

genes.context: Gillmore JD, Maurer MS, Falk RH, et al. Nonbiopsy diagnosis of cardiac transthyretin amyloidosis due to ATTR.
